description.narrative: The development impact of the Project will be delivered through increased access to climate finance for SMEs and corporates in Türkiye. The Project is also a part of IFCs multi-project programmatic approach that aims to deepen the sustainability among Turkish NBFIs by supporting the adoption of climate finance standards, products, and practices by leasing companies and other NBFIs in the Turkish market. IFC will support Aklease to build the necessary frameworks, eligibility screening, and tracking systems to originate and monitor eligible green and blue assets, including water efficiency, pollution prevention, and ocean-friendly projects.

The proposed investment is a senior unsecured loan of up to US$70 million with a tenor of up to 5 years to Ak Finansal Kiralama A.S. (Aklease or the Company). Purpose of the loan is to finance climate-smart loans to small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and corporates in Türkiye, with at least 15% earmarked for women-owned SMEs and at least 20% for Blue Financing (the Project).
